candidates.excerpt: New Delhi: The Delhi Police has de-notified Jantar Mantar as a protest site, telling demonstrators to turn to other designated venues in the national capital instead. candidates.title: Two held with 142.8 kg of ganja worth Rs 71.40 lakh in Sangareddy
candidates.excerpt: Sangareddy police arrested two men from Odisha for allegedly transporting 142.8 kg of dry ganja in two cars. Acting on a tip-off, police intercepted the vehicles at Kandi Cross Road on NH-65 and seized the contraband worth Rs 71.40 lakh.

candidates.title: Suspected IED explodes in J&K's Poonch; security heightened
candidates.excerpt: An explosion was reported in the Satwal-Naki area near the Line of Control in Jammu and Kashmir. Security measures were heightened as officials assessed the situation following the blast. It remains unclear whether the individuals involved were terrorists or Pakistani security personnel. Indian Army troops detected and destroyed two rusted landmines during ongoing operations in the Mendhar sector.
